author: RedTape
quote: 30 fps in 2026 is just insulting, the tutorial for this game is 10 hours of complete boredom. They removed a ton of core elements that GTA fans are used to. You are constantly baby sitting your girlfriend Lucia, shopping and buying her presents. You cannot steal vehicles in your neighborhood, A TON of protected npcs you cannot do anything with. What were they thinking.

quote:
Refunded. The game has lts dark and gritty nature. Unoriginality seeps into the cracks with reused characters. abysmal dialogue and story writing.

Long do i miss the days of the Grey Warden.
